title: Transient Customer Response to Data Breaches of Their Information
eligible_reason: Single-date event: the food-delivery platform breach on 18 May 2017 hits all customers at once; the DiD compares digital vs cash payment orders (c.t#c.digital with week-zone FE) around that date. Bank and grocery breaches are separate single-date events. Entry/exit analyses are cross-sectional logit/OLS. Data are not shipped (confidentiality agreement; on-site access at NUS).
design_notes: Week-payment-type-zone panel; reghdfe ln_count c.t#c.digital digital, absorb(week_zone), cluster city2; windows 2017w16-w23 and w16-w31 excluding w20-w27. Customer-level logit of quitting and OLS of digital share.

specs.exclusion_reason: single common breach date; data not shipped

data_provenance_note: README: data from a food delivery platform cannot be made public; only code, log, dictionary and output files are shipped.
screener_notes: Not staggered; no data. Screened from package only.
